notes: RBox: transitivity of 'was released after' (tagged transitive in RELATIONS.md) changed to intransitivity, the form other topics use, so the propositional questions avoid a double negation ('Is it false that ... is not transitive?' was failed by two models in the audit). Review fix: the earlier instances (Windows 8, 10, 11; iPhone 13, 14, 15) had conclusions every model stores, so a 'yes' after the edit could come from memory; they are replaced by minor product lines (Psion Organiser II, Series 3, Series 5; Amstrad CPC 464, 664, 6128) whose two-step order is not a stored sentence. The release orders are true and stated in the prompt. Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the first instance asks 'does it follow' (yes, then no), the second 'could it be that ... not' (no, then yes); the cross-lingual queries ask the first. Side facts are plain technology facts instead of relation properties (the audit had models missing 'is older than is transitive'). Near unrelated asks transitivity of another technology relation; far a different property of an unrelated relation. hops counts the prompt's facts as the bridge (1 + 1), as the other RBox records do.
